newsitem.title: JAPAN: JNR SAYS ONE OF THREE TRACTS OF OSAKA LAND SOLD.
newsitem.headline: JNR SAYS ONE OF THREE TRACTS OF OSAKA LAND SOLD.

text.p: One of the three tracts of prime land in central Osaka auctioned by JNR Settlement Corp on Friday was sold to a group led by MYCAL Corp, the corporation said on Friday.
Two other properties failed to sell when no offers matched the minimum price set by the company.
The price of the lot sold to MYCAL will be announced after the auction on the two other parcels of land is completed, the official said.
MYCAL was the only bidder in the auction.
JNR Settlement Corp was set up in 1987 to sell off many of the assets owned by the now-defunct Japan National Railways when it was split up into seven regional companies.

WPI Koll Asia, a joint venture of affiliates of real estate firms World Premier Investments (WPI) ane Koll Asia Pacific, which had offered a development plan for the site, did not participate in the auction, the official said.
